data.one_liner: A wrapper widget to animate borders and glows around widgets using gradients.
data.what_it_does: It provides an AnimatedGradientBorder wrapper widget that adds animated borders and glowing effects to any child widget. Developers can either let it loop indefinitely or control the animation progress externally.
use_when: You want to highlight a specific UI element with an animated glowing border.
You need a custom gradient border that loops an animation continuously.
avoid_when: You need to use it extensively throughout the app, as the underlying Backdrop Filter can cause performance issues.
You are using stretched alignments without providing the stretchAlongAxis parameter.
strengths: Easy to wrap around existing widgets.
Supports both indefinite looping and manual animation progress control.
Customizable border size, glow size, and gradient colors.
weaknesses: Uses Backdrop Filter under the hood which may impact performance if used heavily.
Requires matching border radius on both the wrapper and the child for a true border effect.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive general-purpose animation library for widgets instead of just specialized borders.

data.minimal_example:
AnimatedGradientBorder(
  borderSize: 2,
  glowSize: 10,
  gradientColors: [
    Colors.transparent,
    Colors.purple.shade50
  ],
  borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(16)),
  child: Container(width: 100, height: 100),
)
